summary.text: Corinna Cole is an unenrolled candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 144 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Karen Gerrish.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as caregiver and graphic designer.

paragraphs.text: Cole was born in Rochester, New Hampshire, and earned a high school diploma from Sanford Regional Vocational High School, according to Ballotpedia.

Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as including Three Rivers Land Trust, Lake Stewards of Maine, Maine Green Cross, the USM Volunteer Master Gardener program, the Lebanon Historical Society and the Lebanon Conservation Committee.

In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Cole said she would work to bring essential services to underserved seniors, find funding to repair roads and bridges, and protect the health of lakes and watersheds while promoting land conservation.
